title: Silicon Data launches GPU rental pricing index with Chicago Board of Trade integration
summary: The American startup Silicon Data announced the creation of an index that aggregates and normalizes GPU rental prices (H100, H200) from data centers. The index is set to be used by the Chicago Board of Trade starting in October 2026 for B200 and H100 futures contracts, pricing rent as 'Silicon Data index +5%'.
